native.boundary: Inventory lists size 0x90; native RET is at 0xef98 and bytes 0xef99..0xef9f are alignment NOPs. The size is an inventory span, not a new universal boundary claim.

contract: The signed z comparison is inclusive at -0x100000 for the 0x20b50 query branch; z < -0x100000 takes the short flag-update branch.
Fast and sentinel paths read BYTE actor+0x25 and DWORD actor+0x54, store the status byte first, then store the full flags DWORD after clearing low-byte bit 3.
Query path passes SAR(x,16), SAR(y,16), SAR(z,16), and zero-extended WORD actor+0x38 to cdecl 0x20b50; only its low WORD result is used.

Non-sentinel results read/store actor+0x25 after the query. Results <= 0x100 write WORD actor+0x28 and then reload/OR/store DWORD actor+0x54; results > 0x100 skip the WORD write and reload/clear/store the DWORD flags.
abi: void __cdecl (Actor *). Eight recorded direct callers push one actor pointer, clean four stack bytes, and never consume post-call EAX. Native incidental EAX is outside the source claim.
callsite_evidence: All eight caller sites immediately push their actor register and add four to ESP after the call; inspection of the following instructions found no post-call EAX consumption.
negative_hypothesis: work/eng1_behavioral/eng1_call_ef10/history/reversed_cutoff_falsified.json records the first reversed-threshold interpretation and the native discriminator that corrected it.
scope: Five finite direct native-x86 comparisons of complete actor records. The candidate calls the current ordinary-C 0x20b50 and 0x20990 providers with their measured data owners; those providers have independent bounded tests. No function-byte match, full behavior, historical TU/source, or whole-DLL claim.
state_restoration: Before unloading the read-only mapped DLL, the fixture restores every changed original cell (0x70d01, 0x70ece, 0x70d14, 0x70d34, 0x70dcc, 0x70e0c, 0x70e2c). It also restores the source provider's corresponding mutable cells.
integrator_audit: Signed z >= -0x100000 selects query. Preserve DWORD flags load before BYTE state store on short/sentinel paths, unsigned low-WORD >0x100 branch, and post-query live reads. Only eight recorded direct callers support void return; incidental EAX remains unclaimed.

canonical_proof.scope: Five original-x86 full-Actor comparisons using actual source grid query/decoder. Signed z boundary/one-below and low-WORD results zero, 0x100, 0x101 and sentinel 0x7fff. Loaded native and source data cells restored. No wider grid, raw-EAX or whole-game equivalence.
